name: loop-variable
description: A binary reached through a loop variable, beside an argv list bound to a name.

argv:
import shutil, subprocess
TOOLS = ['alpha-tool', 'beta-tool']
for t in TOOLS:
    if shutil.which(t):
        subprocess.run([t, '--version'], capture_output=True)
argv = ['listing-tool', '-axo', 'pid=,rss=']
subprocess.run(argv, capture_output=True)
